title: Associated and weakly associated points agree locally Noetherianly
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and let O_X be its structure sheaf [def-pc-scheme]. The associated points of O_X are exactly its weakly associated points: Ass(O_X) = WeakAss(O_X). Here a point is weakly associated when the maximal ideal of its local ring is weakly associated to that local ring, meaning it is minimal among the prime ideals containing the annihilator of some element.
